'''Vondarc''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Vondarc system/Legends|Vondarc system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], that served as one of the endpoints of the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroute]].

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Battle at Vondarc|fought]] ably at Vondarc, where they achieved a notable victory.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

The crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' docked in [[Vonport]] during their search for [[Dass Jennir]]. The city was garrisoned with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] when they arrived, but they managed to get through without much trouble. [[Beyghor Sahdett]], [[Bomo Greenbark]], [[Meekerdin-maa]], and [[Ko Vakier]] later [[Mission to Vondarc|raided]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] guard station to hack into the Empire's [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] for clues on Jennir. The information they recovered led them to the desert world of [[Prine]], where they indeed found who they were looking for.<ref name="DT19" />

After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]] acquired a large force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] and other [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] on Vondarc, which prompted him to invent the title of "[[Superior General]]."<ref name="TIW:DoaE2" />
